name: art.travel/mcp
title: travel.art
description: Verified art-travel data: art events, museum hours and room status by date, layovers, itineraries.

tools.name: find_art_events
tools.description: Search travel.art's calendar of art events — biennales, art fairs, festivals, major museum exhibitions. Returns dates, city, venues, ticket summary and prices by tier, status (scheduled / postponed / cancelled), last-verified date and a link to the travel.art guide. Ended events are excluded unless includePast is true or the date filters ask for the past. Example questions: 'when is documenta 16', 'art fairs in March 2027', 'what's on in London in October'.

query.description: Free text: event name, artist, theme, venue, city. Optional.

activeOn.description: Only events running on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

startsAfter.description: Only events starting on or after this date. Optional.

endsBefore.description: Only events ending on or before this date. Optional.

includePast.description: Include events that have already ended. Default false.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full visitor facts for one art event: dates, status, every venue with address and coordinates, ticket prices by tier with conditions, day-by-day opening hours, highlights, FAQ from the travel.art guide, other events in the same city at the same time, and where to eat / stay nearby when the guide has a map. Accepts an event id (for example art-basel-miami-2026) or an event name.

tools.name: find_museum_guide
tools.description: travel.art's museum visitor guides (Louvre, Vatican Museums, Uffizi, British Museum, Prado, Met, MoMA and more): ticket prices, booking advice, opening hours by weekday, closed days, entrance, essential works in viewing order, route duration and a link to the full route. Example questions: 'how to visit the Louvre', 'is the Uffizi open on Monday', 'British Museum must-see'.

query.description: Museum name, artwork, artist or city. Optional.

tools.name: check_museum_day
tools.description: Is the museum open on a given date, what are the hours, and which rooms are closed. For museums with a room-by-room route (currently the British Museum) it returns every stop of the travel.art route with its status for that date — open, closed, 'check on the day' — and the looking time that remains. Example questions: 'can I see the Rosetta Stone on 16 January', 'is the Louvre open on Tuesday 2 March'.

evening.description: Visiting during a late (Friday evening) opening. Default false.

tools.name: find_layover_itinerary
tools.description: travel.art's short art trips for a flight connection (3–6 hours on the ground) from hub airports: which airport, transfer time and fare into the city, minimum layover, the art to see, days to avoid, and a link to the hour-by-hour plan. Example questions: 'art layover in Rome from Fiumicino', '5 hours at Heathrow', 'Louvre from CDG between flights'.

query.description: City, artist, museum, airport or theme. Optional.

maxDurationHours.description: Only plans that fit in this many hours on the ground. Optional.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Places travel.art maps around a museum, art fair or city guide: where to eat, where to stay, galleries, nearby museums, stations and entrances — with address, coordinates, a one-line editor's note, the official website and a Google Maps directions URL. Example questions: 'where to eat near the British Museum', 'hotels for Art Basel Miami'.

near.description: Museum, event or city guide name or id (e.g. 'British Museum', 'art-basel-miami-2026', 'Paris'). Optional if city is given.

city.description: City — all mapped places in the city. Optional.

category.description: Filter by category (eat, hotel, gallery, museum…). Optional.

tools.name: get_city_itinerary
tools.description: travel.art's day-by-day art itinerary for a city (2–3 days): what to see each day, in which area, plus the city's museum routes, art events on the given dates and cities within reach by train or car. Example questions: '3 days of art in Paris', 'Berlin art weekend'.

startDate.description: Trip start (optional) — adds events running then.

tools.name: recommend_art_trip
tools.description: Build an art trip for a city from travel.art's published guides only: events running on the trip dates, museum routes, the city itinerary, layover plans, and cities within reach (travel time, mode) with their events on the same dates. No invented facts — everything links to a travel.art guide.
